context.body: Divine attention to suffering leads to a human commission and a disclosed name.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: God appears in fire, declares Israel’s suffering seen and heard, commissions Moses, and gives the name tied to “I AM.”
observations.label: God hears and names himself: action

observations.body: Moses turns aside, hides his face, objects, and asks what name to give Israel.
observations.label: God hears and names himself: response

observations.body: holy ground · I have seen · I AM · the LORD
observations.label: Words in Exodus 3:1–15

payload.posture: Read Exodus 3:1–15 as name and deliverance evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The name is given through compact Hebrew wording whose full force is not exhausted by one English rendering.
payload.title: God hears and names himself
